biocs.name: Globally Uncommon Root Domain from Signed Process
biocs.description: Detection of network traffic to a root domain not commonly seen in the organization, originating from a signed process
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_OUTBOUND
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe' and action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.1'
| filter not in(action_remote_ip, (select distinct action_remote_ip from xdr_data where causality_actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe' and event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION))
